latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Kuikly App Builder Skill.

- Enables creation, building, and preview of cross-platform mobile apps using Kuikly (Kotlin Multiplatform) via CLI.
- Ensures strict filesystem and tool usage boundaries for safety—modifies files only within project or references directories.
- Requires both JDK 17 and Android SDK to build; checks are enforced and users are prompted if missing.
- Guides complete project workflow: repo initialization, environment check, project/page creation, and code-writing procedures.
- Detailed command reference and environment variable requirements provided for robust, reproducible usage.
